note: Upcoming events that tend to spark memecoin themes. Researched from news on the date above; dates can move. strength: 1 = niche, 2 = big online moment, 3 = mainstream / worldwide.

events.title: Anthropic IPO (ticker ANT)
events.why: The biggest AI listing ever (~$1.4T target). AI and 'IPO' tokens usually spike around big listings, and Robinhood Chain already pairs memecoins with tokenized stocks.

events.title: GTA 6 launches
events.why: The most hyped game in years. GTA tokens are already trending on Solana, and the launch week will flood social feeds with Vice City clips.

events.title: OKX tokenized-stock venue opens
events.why: 70+ tokenized assets including Robinhood shares. Keeps the 'stocks on-chain' theme hot, and puts attention on X Layer, OKX's own chain.

events.title: Thanksgiving and Black Friday (US)
events.why: Food and holiday memes appear every year, but US traders are offline, so volume is usually thin.

events.title: Spotify Wrapped 2026 (expected date)
events.why: Everyone posts their Wrapped on the same day, so the year's top artists trend everywhere. Not confirmed by Spotify yet; past years dropped on the first Wednesday of December.

events.title: US Fed rate decision
events.why: Traders were pricing a likely rate hike. Not a theme to launch into: a hike can drain risk appetite across all memecoins for a few days.

events.title: The Game Awards
events.why: GTA 6 is eligible, so a second wave of gaming hype three weeks after launch.

events.title: Avengers: Doomsday and Dune: Part Three
events.why: Two of the biggest films of the year open the same day. Superhero and villain names (Doom, Avengers) and Dune names (Spice, Shai-Hulud) are easy meme picks.

events.title: Christmas, plus 'Artificial' (the Sam Altman film)
events.why: Santa and holiday tokens appear every December. The Sam Altman film opening on Christmas Day adds an AI angle.

fading.why: The Trump memecoin hit record lows after the midterm results. Political tokens are losing attention.
